In this masterclass you distinguish northern temple forms through comparative plans.

Length, level and language are agreed with you. It can be given online or at your venue, as a single session or as part of a series.

What it covers

  • Type vocabulary
  • Regional comparisons
  • Khajuraho reading

How the time is spent

  1. Type vocabulary 30 min

    Latina, śekharī and bhūmija terms with examples.

    You: classify sample elevations

  2. Regional comparisons 60 min

    Compare central India, Rajasthan and western India case studies.

    You: morphology grid

  3. Khajuraho reading 30 min

    Analyse plan and superstructure.

    You: label photograph

Timings are a guide. The plan is confirmed with your quotation.
